rule_yaml:
rules:
  - id: dubbo-npe-c1-merged
    languages:
      - java
    severity: ERROR
    message: >-
      A nullable URL value — either the 'urlAddress' component field left null
      by the no-arg constructor chain (URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder())
      or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() /
      getValidServiceInfo()) — is dereferenced without a null check. This can
      throw a NullPointerException. Guard the value with a null check before
      using it.
    paths:
      exclude:
        - "**/src/test/**"
        - "**/test/**"
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          # --- Case c1-4: urlAddress field dereferenced ---
          - patterns:
              - pattern-either:
                  - pattern: |
                      $T $V = urlAddress.$M(...);
                      return $R($V);
                  - pattern: |
                      return urlAddress.$M(...);
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress == null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress != null ...>) {
                    ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress == null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress != null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (...) {
                    ...
                  }
          # --- Case c1-1: service-info lookup result dereferenced ---
          - pattern: getServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - pattern: getValidServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - patterns:
              - pattern-inside: |
                  $TYPE $SI = $LOOKUP(...);
                  ...
              - metavariable-regex:
                  metavariable: $LOOKUP
                  regex: '(getServiceInfo|getValidServiceInfo)$'
              - pattern: $SI.$M(...)
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null != $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI != null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null == $SI ? $A : $SI.$M(...)'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$SI == null ? $A : $SI.$M(...)'
              - pattern-not-inside: 'null != $SI ? $SI.$M(...) : $A'
              - pattern-not-inside: '$SI != null ? $SI.$M(...) : $A'
commonality: A nullable URL value — either the 'urlAddress' field left null by the no-arg constructor chain or the result of a nullable getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo() lookup — is dereferenced without a null guard; guard before use.
message: A nullable URL value — either the 'urlAddress' component field left null by the no-arg constructor chain (URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()) or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo()) — is dereferenced without a null check. This can throw a NullPointerException. Guard the value with a null check before using it.
